question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (3)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**image**" refers to the perception or reputation that someone has in a particular context. (छवि)
 
• In this context, a positive "image" in the workplace means being perceived positively by colleagues and supervisors.
 
• The other options: "**face**," "**mask**," and "**firework**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *When you start a new job, you want to make a good impression on your colleagues and supervisors. Behaving professionally, being punctual, and following company policies and procedures can help you establish a positive **image**__ in the workplace.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Face (चेहरा)**: refers to the front part of a person's head. It is not suitable in this context.
 
• **Mask (नकाब)**: refers to a covering worn on the face. It is not appropriate here.
 
• **Firework (पटाखा)**: refers to a device containing gunpowder and other combustible chemicals that causes a spectacular explosion. It is not appropriate here.
